experiments.name: Experiment A: Local Algorithm Baselines
experiments.description: Sequential latency distributions (p50, p95, p99, p99.9) and throughput for local limiters.

experiments.name: Experiment B: Distributed Credit Conservation Invariant
experiments.description: Concurrent load against 3 lease-backed nodes with zero refill. Proves global overspend is exactly 0.

experiments.name: Experiment C: Duplicate and Out-of-Order Report Accounting
experiments.description: Demonstrates monotonic cumulative reporting resilience to duplicate and reordered deliveries.

experiments.name: Experiment D: Partition, Depletion, Heal, and Recovery
experiments.description: Measures traffic allowed from cached lease, bounded denials after exhaustion, and recovery upon heal.

experiments.name: Experiment E: Uncoordinated Local Baseline Comparison
experiments.description: Demonstrates how independent uncoordinated limiters cause N-fold quota overshoot (200% overshoot across 3 nodes).

experiments.name: Experiment F: CRDT Telemetry Convergence under Packet Loss
experiments.description: Measures G-counter eventual convergence after 60% lossy gossip rounds followed by anti-entropy heal.

experiments.name: Experiment G: Node Restart and Incarnation Binding
experiments.description: Verifies that restarting a node generates a new incarnation that cannot spend or report stale grants.

experiments.name: Experiment H: Tenant Skew and High Cardinality Churn
experiments.description: Simulates 10,000 requests under Zipfian tenant skew; evaluates memory footprint and cardinality stability.
